# BiharFast

BiharFast is an independent public-information portal for Bihar students, job aspirants, and public-service seekers. It organizes job notices, admit cards, results, schemes, exam practice, and service guides, and links users to source portals where available. BiharFast is not a government website.

## Main resources

- [Home and latest updates](https://biharfast.in/)
- [Job notices](https://biharfast.in/jobs)
- [Admit cards](https://biharfast.in/admit-card)
- [Results](https://biharfast.in/results)
- [All updates and category listings](https://biharfast.in/all-updates)
- [Site directory](https://biharfast.in/sitemap)
- [Live mock tests](https://biharfast.in/mock-test)
- [Student dashboard](https://biharfast.in/dashboard)

## Bihar service and education guides

- [BSEB Class 12 results and resources](https://biharfast.in/bseb-inter-12th)
